note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts, provisions, levels and readings are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. States are supplied by the author, never inferred; no text is shown to prevail and the hierarchy is only displayed.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Two fictional provisions are brought together on a reading desk; their tension phrases are highlighted, the reader inspects the zone with a lens and the assistant sets a pennant pin for the supplied state 'conflict flagged'.
